A brief summary page from a quality inspection report, heralding the birth of a hero.

Product ID: λ-031-██-████
Inspection Period: ██/██/████ to ██/██/████
Inspection Supervisor: Mastaka

Wishpower
• Stability:
        Wishpower output fluctuation rate in normal state: ≤1.5%. Peak fluctuation rate under emotional and load stress: ≤5%.
        Probability of Wishpower entering out of control state under extreme Wishpower impact: ≤10%. Recovery time to stable Wishpower state after impact ends: ≤30 seconds.
• Endurance:
        Under maximum-load combat state, Wishpower reserves can sustain operation for approximately 48 system hours.
        After depletion, Wishpower can be restored to 50% within 12 minutes using a resonance device.

Constitution
• Strength:
        Max Lift Capacity: 850 metric tons.
        Burst Power: Peak striking impact reaching 4,200 metric tons.
• Damage Resistance:
        External Resistance: Skin effectively resists direct fire from standard small-caliber kinetic weapons; 87% energy attack absorption rate.
        Structural Resistance: Body withstands 200x standard gravitational acceleration with no structural damage.
• Recovery:
        Superficial wounds healing time ≤30 seconds.
        Severe tissue regeneration time ≤15 minutes.
        Wishpower consumption during self-healing remains within expected parameters.

Psychology
• Breakdown Resistance:
        Underwent extended combat simulation spanning 7,200 consecutive system hours, no permanent psychological trauma recorded.
        Psychological breakdown threshold exceeded the average baseline by approximately 34% under extreme stress testing.
• Cognitive Controllability:
        Combat directive compliance rate reached 100% in the absence of conflicting instructions.
        When presented with moral paradox scenarios, approximately 97% probability of adhering to preset moral guidelines when making decisions.
        Memory implants remain stable, with minimal instances of intra-cognition conflict.

Equipment
• Power Armor Compatibility:
        Consciousness sync rate at 99.7%, with maximum sync latency below 2 microseconds.
        Wishpower-to-power armor energy circuit coupling efficiency rate of 96.5%, with minimal energy loss and no overload risk.
        Emergency ejection function: passed. Zero frame-lock failures recorded across 10,000 cumulative ejection tests.

Overall Assessment
• Quality Inspection Conclusion: All test parameters meet factory standards.
• Cleared for Distribution: Yes.
• Designated ID: "996"
